candidates.title: CJP Protest Today LIVE: Security tightened, Connaught Place’s Central Park shut; Dipke ‘under constant surveillance’
candidates.excerpt: CJP Protest Today LIVE: Ahead of the Tiranga march, CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke alleged he was being tailed. “The place I am staying at has been surrounded by undercover cops from all sides…The white Scorpio has also been following me everywhere,” he said.

candidates.excerpt: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman has called for an early conclusion to the proposed India-US trade agreement, citing benefits for bilateral economic ties and global trade. Her remarks follow signals from Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal and US Ambassador Sergio Gor

candidates.title: Govt raises petrol export duty to Rs 2.5 per litre, slashes for diesel
candidates.excerpt: The government has raised the windfall tax on exports of petrol to Rs 2.5 per litre and cut the duty on diesel, effective from Friday.
